title: complete_post uses hardcoded DEFAULT_MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES, ignores operator config limit
description: TRIGGER: Operator sets a custom max_article_bytes in reader config (smaller or larger than DEFAULT_MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES). BEHAVIOR: In crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs, the call to complete_post passes DEFAULT_MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES (the compile-time constant) instead of config.limits.max_article_bytes. Articles up to DEFAULT_MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES are accepted regardless of the operator's configured limit. An operator who lowers the limit to reduce storage load or enforce policy cannot enforce that limit via POST; a client can post articles larger than the configured maximum as long as they are under the hardcoded default.
